stemMd: A drug disrupts microtubule assembly but not actin polymerisation. Which structure is most directly affected?

options.label: B
options.textMd: The internal supporting apparatus of a motile eukaryotic cilium

options.label: E
options.textMd: The cellulose chains of a plant cell wall

explanationMd: Motile eukaryotic cilia contain an organised microtubule apparatus. Microtubules are assembled from tubulin, so a drug targeting their assembly affects ciliary structure directly.

distractorRationale.d: Lipids do not require microtubule polymerisation to form a bilayer.
distractorRationale.a: DNA is not a polymer of tubulin.
distractorRationale.c: Protein sequence is not a microtubule structure.
